description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Revived Daughter Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Revived Daughter Mode
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] and [100% Critical 1] to the user when the user's HP falls below 20%, removed after triggering
